packageRules.description: git_dir is the Makefile's named build context that `COPY --from` reads, not an image

Every minor and patch update in one PR, from renovate/all-minor-patch, a branch name every ODM repo shares: TeamCity's gate builds that name in each repo that has it, so one gate run tests the updates of all of them. Keep it the last rule: a later groupName would take updates out of it
